limitations: Only same-basic-block constant strings, verified helpers and method setters; resets at every branch destination, branch fallthrough, return and handler move-exception.
Register copies preserve object identity. Register overwrites kill values. Calls receiving tracked objects invalidate configuration unless explicitly recognized.
Observations prove route and HTTP method configured on the same receiver at a point in code; later overrides, actual dispatch, server existence, authorization and success are not proven.
No string concatenation, formatting, field-loaded paths, dynamic server payloads or interprocedural recovery. No default HTTP methods assumed.
HTTP enum/helper semantics rely on REA-decompiled evidence in api/evidence. POST and GET mappings only. No network traffic generated.
